description: Start a Mint world generation lifecycle from prompt and optional image inputs, creating a new Mint chat unless chat_id is supplied. project_id is required when chat_id is absent; when both are supplied they must match. This is an explicit environment-level operation with a longer generation and post-processing lifecycle: prefer discrete model or asset-pack generation for ordinary 3D scene composition, and call this tool only when the user directly requests a Mint-generated world/environment or approves that choice. Provide a prompt, an image, or both. Image-only prompts are supported. Reference images: pass public direct image URLs via image_url or up to 6 URLs in source_images; simple public share pages with og:image, twitter:image, or image_src metadata may also work. The server fetches and stashes reference images to Mint CDN automatically. Use upload_reference_image only when you have local bytes or want a reusable CDN URL. source_url is source-page metadata only - Mint does not fetch it. Use image_url / source_images for reference images. mode: "auto" is the default and proceeds through RAD post-processing before reporting success. Set mode: "review" only when the user explicitly asks to inspect, compare, revise, select, or approve a preview before final generation; then use revise_preview or approve_final_generation to continue. Show the returned chatUrl to the user as a clickable link so they can open the generation in Mint. Keep assetId for follow-up tool calls and use nextSteps for polling, then get_asset_artifact_manifest for the remote SparkJS and invisible-collider runtime contract; do not show raw IDs unless the user asks. If status is billing_required, generationStarted is false: use billing.userMessage as the core user response, explain the account entitlement or credit shortfall without promoting subscriptions, upgrades, or credit purchases, and present billing.chatUrl as a blocked request that can resume after billing is resolved. Do not call it a failed generation.

image_url.description: Public direct image URL. Simple share pages with public image metadata may also work.

items.description: Public direct image URL. Simple share pages with public image metadata may also work.

source_url.description: Source-page metadata only. Mint does not fetch this URL; use image_url or source_images for reference images.
